title.description: Display name of the dashboard; with parent_path it locates the dashboard in every environment

content.description: YAML file (relative to maya.yaml): the audience, KPIs and filters each page must show

metric_views.description: Metric views the dashboard may use (full names or view names). Default: every metric view of G2

credentials.description: embedded: viewers see data with the publisher's access; viewer: with their own (masks and row filters of G4 apply)

cron.description: Quartz cron expression, for example '0 0 7 * * ?' (07:00 daily)

schedule.description: Refresh schedule; subscribers receive a snapshot after each refresh

user.description: User name (email) of a workspace user

destination.description: Id of a notification destination (email list, Slack, Teams)

subscribers.description: Who receives the scheduled snapshot (needs a schedule)

access.description: Who may open the dashboard (account-level groups or service principals). Data access itself comes from G4

parent_path.description: Workspace folder of the dashboard; relative paths are under the deploying identity's home

mode.description: full re-authors every page; incremental reuses the certified layout of unchanged pages

kpis.description: Measures the page must show: <metric view>.<measure>, or a measure name that only one view has

filters.description: Dimensions the page must be filterable by

notes.description: Anything else the page should show, in plain language
